description: This file defines a custom security filter for handling public login requests via REST API in the Thingsboard platform. It processes authentication requests, validates input, and delegates authentication handling.

classes.name: RestPublicLoginProcessingFilter
classes.description: A security filter that processes REST login requests for public authentication, extending Spring Security's AbstractAuthenticationProcessingFilter.

methods.name: RestPublicLoginProcessingFilter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the filter with URL and success/failure handlers.

methods.name: attemptAuthentication
methods.description: Handles authentication attempts by parsing login request, validating public ID, and creating authentication token.

methods.name: successfulAuthentication
methods.description: Invokes success handler upon successful authentication.

methods.name: unsuccessfulAuthentication
methods.description: Clears security context and invokes failure handler upon failed authentication.
